crossRefs.note: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

translations.web: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
translations.bsb: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God has composed the body and has given greater honor to the parts that lacked it,
translations.kjv: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered ➔ the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:
translations.asv: whereas our comely parts have no need: but God tempered the body together, giving more abundant honor to that part which lacked;
